O1.name: No replayable bridge schema
O1.rule: No relevant replayed schema, legal match, or latent match.

O2.name: Schema exists but cannot match target vocabulary
O2.rule: Skeleton distance <= 2, with neither a legal nor latent exact match.

O3.name: Match requires an unbound or latent term
O3.rule: An exact matched side leaves replacement variables unbound and no legal match exists.

O4.name: Activation occurs but normal forms diverge locally
O4.rule: Productive activation; shared context depth >= 1; paired frontier size <= 12.

O5.name: Divergence requires a derived operation
O5.rule: Nonlocal activated divergence with a non-root anti-unified multi-input shape.

O6.name: Divergence suggests an invariant or quotient
O6.rule: Reserved for recurrent relation-like candidate objects; single-row evidence is secondary only.

O7.name: Divergence suggests decomposition or cases
O7.rule: Reserved for recurrent finite split signatures; single-row evidence is secondary only.

O8.name: More than two representation changes appear necessary
O8.rule: Legal bridge states exist and reduce a frontier, but no activation survives the two-step frozen search.

O9.name: Proof DAG nearly connects but lacks a reusable schematic consequence
O9.rule: At least two verified components and closest target frontier distance <= 2.

O10.name: Unclassified
O10.rule: No frozen rule applies with confidence >= 0.60.

earliest_failure_stages.F2: target-relevant schema, no concrete legal match
earliest_failure_stages.F6: near-connected proof DAG, missing schematic consequence
